scope: All 35 BMO1 papers (archive years 1992–2026) and all 19 accessible historical first-stage BMO papers (1973–1991). BMO2 and FIST are excluded.
ratingMethod: Unweighted arithmetic mean of every question’s individual difficulty estimate. Historical papers use their actual question count. No whole-paper mean is shown when a question is unavailable. These are AI estimates, not official UKMT ratings.
yearConvention: Archive years identify the competition cycle. A November/December sitting can occur in the preceding calendar year; exact sitting dates are retained where verified.

gaps.reason: The official archive says original papers for these years are not available online. They are not included or rated here.

templates.title: BMO1 2023–24
subtopics: Power of a point & radical axes

calibration.method: Reuse topic sequences and individually reviewed difficulty profiles from complete six-question BMO1 papers in the last ten archived seasons. The exceptional seven-question 2020–21 paper is excluded. Real profiles need not increase strictly with question number. Templates guide selection only; they never assign a question rating.

excludedReferencePapers.reason: Seven-question exceptional format, including answer-only questions.

calibration.suitabilityNote: Match elementary olympiad methods as well as rating; exclude calculus, advanced linear algebra and projective/conic prerequisites. Exclude all British BMO/BMO1/BMO2/FIST appearances, including known duplicate appearances under another contest name. Balkan competitions with the abbreviation BMO are distinct.

formatSources.role: Official archive, six-question format, duration, historical format changes and unavailable years.
Modern instructions and layout: A4 portrait, instruction cover, numbered proof questions, 3½ hours and 10 marks per question.
